doc.title: Janis Siegel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 22, 2015

title: What makes her angry: lateness on the road
summary: Messy dorm rooms and, on the road, unprofessional lateness showing disrespect.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Well just to wrap up, is there anything that pushes your buttons and makes you angry in particular?
Messy dorm rooms, yes. Not being ready to be driven home.
Angry? Well I mean it’s a broad, broad question. I mean you know in my situation on the road I expect everyone to act professional. I don’t like people that are constantly late for things.
Late. Don’t show up on time. Yeah. I think it shows a disrespect and an entitlement.
